visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Generator Instead of Building a List
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The function collects every Fibonacci number in a list before returning it. Make it a generator with yield. The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
def fibonacci(limit):
    result = []
    a, b = 0, 1
    while a < limit:
        result.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return result


print(fibonacci(50))

solution.explanation: A generator produces one value at a time, so the caller can stop early or loop over huge ranges without storing them. list() collects the values when a list is really needed.
